name: Matsushima (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Matsushima town emblem in white: a disc with a stylised character of three horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Matsushima, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 16 December 1963.

features.role: Matsushima town emblem — a disc with a stylised character of three horizontal strokes
